implemented_scope: Complete implicit primitive row-domain counts/iteration, exact marking and rollback, global scheduler, full base fallback and fixed immutable preference-set control; synthetic and full-model evidence must be reported separately.

cluster_continuation_gap.observation: Executor.solve validates the full supplied cluster only once. Later candidates_with_preferences filters individually illegal members while remaining members can retain preference. It does not retire an invalid whole pending cluster or trail a mutable hint lifecycle.
cluster_continuation_gap.claim_not_made: Full GCTS cluster-continuation conformance is not established by v1/v2.
required_future_version: Revalidate the entire pending cluster against each node/state after global propagation.
Retire all preferences for a cluster if any pending constituent invalidates it.
Keep valid but currently ineligible hints waiting without bypassing forced/earliest decisions.
Trail waiting/retired hint state per branch; rollback restores prior hint state.
Keep complete base counts and fallback unchanged, and independently test interruption/invalidation/revival.

root_review_origin: Root read-only source review before the v2 retry.
